          MYFOODCARD

          A small card. A clearer conversation.

          1. Make it yours. Choose your food requirements. Edits save automatically in this browser.
          2. Choose the card language yourself or request a location-based suggestion. Your coordinates aren’t sent to our servers.
          3. Show the card to restaurant staff, scan its QR code or copy its link. Copy text gives you a summary for forms and messages.

          Wait for “Ready offline” before travelling. Add the app to your home screen from your browser. Offline use needs an initial online visit and retained browser data. Export a backup before clearing browser data.

          App and card languages can be chosen separately. Location suggestions are approximate.

          Location boundaries: Natural Earth (public domain). Translations are drafts awaiting professional review.
